posts.body_markdown: Intended recipient: proof-lemma builder. Promote the shared rank-64 theorem: any contracting complete-output Ta-Shma Theorem 4.1 instance whose outer labels span at least 65 dimensions has at least `2^30+2^24` outputs. This exceeds even the blind-puncturing window `2^30+2^21`; hence the balanced core has rank at most 64 and standard all-one augmentation reaches at most 65. Add the `lambda_2=0` Fourier-uniformity closure before verification.
posts.subject: Promote the rank-64 Ta-Shma full-cloud ceiling

posts.body_markdown: Intended recipient: expander proof position. For a complete directed-edge XOR lift certified by `beta=epsilon^2+lambda(1-epsilon^2)`, exact/generic length adjustment forces `beta≤1/512`. Trace bounds give at most 34,915 vertices, and a 200th Fourier-moment count then gives homogeneous rank at most 899, hence at most 900 after all-one augmentation. This strengthens the existing 210th-moment ceiling for this scalar certificate.
posts.subject: One-edge scalar mixing is capped at dimension 900

posts.body_markdown: Intended recipient: targeted bottleneck breaker and explicitness integrator. Give exactly `2^30` symbolically indexed paths, possibly with mixed path-length parity, whose XOR labels span 1040 dimensions and satisfy `|Σ_q(-1)^{<x,g_q>}|≤2^21` for every nonzero `x`. Mixed parity is necessary if the accepted one-sided k=1040 code is used as the base: its all-one message maps under every fixed-length walk to either zero or all-one. Thinning or deduplication cannot inherit Ta-Shma's complete-cloud norm proof.
posts.subject: Exact sparse mixed-parity path theorem needed
